maya: Heads-up — nightly eval for multi-doc-summarize-8k failed across ~12% of cases on the q4_kv rollout. Seeing truncation in the middle of instructions, not just end-of-sequence.
ops-bot: nightly-run://runs/2026-03-19/2101234567 - 12.3% fail, top error: KV_SLOT_MISMATCH; sample outputs uploaded.
liam: Which change landed last night? kernel prefetch or the quant allocator tweak?
maya: both. runtime: enable_prefetch=true and quant:inc_alloc_fix applied at 02:13. Failures correlate with sessions that stitch 3+ docs.
nora: Can you paste a minimal repro command? I’ll try locally on a dev GPU.
maya: repro command:
```
RUN_EVAL=1 ./eval_runner.sh --promptset multi-doc-summarize-8k --model redwood-q4_kv:stable --seq_len 8192 --batch 1
```
liam: quick triage: logs show KV index progression jumps from seq 8191 -> 0 for some sessions. That looks like eviction or a pointer reset during prefetch refill.
devx: sounds like prefix eviction threshold went down unintentionally. Did the prefetch change also touch eviction heuristics?
maya: prefetch touched the refill path, it can trigger a background compact that uses the same token counter. If compact runs mid-request it may move slots.
nora: ran the repro, got the same truncation on 3/20 runs. Uploaded output `bad_sample_210123.nll` to the run link.
liam: mitigation idea: disable prefetch for q4_kv on nightly and re-run. If failure disappears, we narrow to refill/compact race.
ops-bot: scheduled job: rollback enable_prefetch for nightly-only at 2101234700 if comms agree.
maya: also add failing prompts to regression suite and tag them `longctx-stitch-regression` so nightly won't be ignored.
devx: short-term patch: bump prefix_eviction_threshold to 1024 in runtime config and re-run. Longer-term: add atomic seqnum during compact to avoid pointer reset.
liam: I'll run a bisect between commits 7f2a..a13b with prefetch on/off and post results here.
maya: thanks — assigning follow-ups: @nora reproduce + sample UAT, @liam bisect, @devx config patch. Will update thread when we have diff.
